topic.title: Global version control
topic.shortdesc: Use the global .ignore file to exclude files from version control across all repositories on your machine.

body.p: The global .ignore file applies across repositories. Automatic ignore actions do not add entries to this file. To exclude files globally, open the global .ignore file and add the entries manually.

section.title: Open global .ignore
section.p: To open the global .ignore file, go to the view.
The global .ignore file opens so you can add, edit, or remove global ignore entries manually.
